text: You see one of Hightower's guards.
source_text: You see one of Hightower's guards.

text: You better leave. Daren Hightower doesn't take visitors.
source_text: You better leave. Daren Hightower doesn't take visitors.

text: Go away, or you'll regret it.
source_text: Go away, or you'll regret it.

text: This house is off limits to the likes of you.

text: 你看见一个海托的守卫。

text: 你最好离开。达伦海托不喜欢来访者。

text: 像你这样的人是不能来这房子对的。

text: You made a big mistake coming in here!

text: What are you doing here?  You're dead meat.
